children: US video game publisher's H1 revenue rose 18% yr/yr on strong catalogue and new launches
Adjusted EBITDA for H1 fell yr/yr due to higher royalty and marketing costs
Company says H1 results were ahead of expectations and maintains full-year outlook above expectations
TinyBuild says much uncertainty remains for H2 2026 in a crowded market
Company says pipeline includes several larger-budget, high-potential new IPs
TinyBuild expects full-year results ahead of company's expectations
NEW GAME LAUNCHES - Co said three successful new IP launches (Hozy, ALL WILL FALL and SAND) expanded its catalogue and contributed to revenue growth
BACK CATALOGUE PERFORMANCE - Continued strong contribution from evergreen franchises, including Hello Neighbor and Graveyard Keeper, supported revenue
HIGHER ROYALTY AND MARKETING COSTS - Co said adjusted EBITDA decline reflected higher royalty payments for second-party releases and increased marketing spend for new launches
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "hold"
The average consensus recommendation for the software peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Tinybuild Inc is GBp8.50, about 43.3% below its September 23 closing price of GBp15.00
The stock recently traded at 57 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 43 three months ago
Sept 21 - Oura targets $15.62 billion valuation in US IPO, setting stage for fall listings
